svg.title: Proportional setpoint-weight comparison on the reactor PI loop
svg.desc: Four panels compare three setpoint weights in fresh servo and regulatory experiments. Weight one-half is the largest weight meeting the servo overshoot requirement, while fixed-setpoint regulatory traces coincide.
svg.text: Setpoint weighting changes reference response without retuning feedback
Three weights, two objectives, and one unchanged reactor PI configuration
b = 0.5 is the largest weight that passes the common servo requirement
The fixed-setpoint regulatory traces coincide: maximum PV and valve difference = 0
Simulation evidence · six fresh runs · 100 ms · seed 20260827
